templates.why_chosen: The central Near-Storage Location, hosting the LVI Server, sits on the axis between two identical Near-User Location panels, each running the same Function Execution/Storage Library/Cache stack, the textbook central-server-flanked-by-two-instances case.
templates.what_to_learn: Flank one central server box with two literally identical copies of the peer panel, mirrored left and right, and route each peer's request/response arrows to the same handler inside the centre box; add colour or distinct line styles to the many double-headed arrows, since this exemplar uses none and they become hard to trace.
